queries.name: format_clock_usage
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT version FROM main.store_meta) store_format,(SELECT position FROM main.clock WHERE singleton) position,(SELECT retained_count FROM main.storage_usage WHERE singleton) retained_count,(SELECT retained_bytes FROM main.storage_usage WHERE singleton) retained_bytes

queries.name: base_counts
queries.sql: SELECT 'commands',count(*)::BIGINT FROM main.commands UNION ALL SELECT 'assertions',count(*)::BIGINT FROM main.assertions UNION ALL SELECT 'entity_batches',count(*)::BIGINT FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_batches UNION ALL SELECT 'entity_batch_members',count(*)::BIGINT FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_batch_members UNION ALL SELECT 'entity_commands',count(*)::BIGINT FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_commands UNION ALL SELECT 'entity_presence_edits',count(*)::BIGINT FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_presence_edits

queries.name: presence_totals
queries.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::BIGINT entities,count(*)::BIGINT events FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_presence_events

queries.name: presence_per_entity
queries.sql: SELECT entity_id,count(*)::BIGINT events,min(position),max(position) FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_presence_events GROUP BY entity_id ORDER BY entity_id

queries.name: target_batch_headers
queries.sql: SELECT b.command_id,c.position,b.member_count,c.request_hash,c.receipt IS NOT NULL FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_batches b JOIN main.commands c USING(command_id) WHERE starts_with(b.command_id,'growth-target-') ORDER BY c.position

queries.name: source_headers
queries.sql: SELECT e.command_id,e.entity_id,e.position,c.request_hash,c.receipt IS NOT NULL FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_commands e JOIN main.commands c USING(command_id) WHERE starts_with(e.command_id,'growth-source-') ORDER BY e.position

queries.name: latest_persisted_receipts
queries.sql: SELECT command_id,position,request_hash,receipt FROM main.commands ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 5

restrictions: READ_ONLY; no LOAD, initializer, owner activation, audit, native command, EXPLAIN or product retry.

reconciliation.interpretation: All authored command IDs are persisted; the failure may be in the post-write queries, revalidation, reopen or final checks. Counts do not distinguish these phases.
reconciliation.acknowledgementCaveat: Persisted headers/receipts reconcile committed state. They do not prove that JavaScript observed an ACK; the first test emitted no per-command ACK log.
